On Fri Sep 4, 2026 at 11:10 AM EDT, Kiryl Shutsemau wrote:
> From: "Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)" <kas@kernel.org>

> collapse_possible() only forwards to collapse_possible_orders() and turns
> its mask into a bool.  Its three callers can test the mask themselves.
>
> No functional change.
>
> Assisted-by: Claude-Code:claude-opus-5
> Signed-off-by: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) <kas@kernel.org>
> ---
>  mm/khugepaged.c | 15 +++++----------

>
LGTM.

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>



-- 
Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the collapse_possible() wrapper function in the mm/collapse module by removing it and directly calling the underlying collapse_possible_orders() function. The change is made possible because the three callers of collapse_possible() can test the mask themselves, making the wrapper function redundant.

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch series aims to simplify the collapse_possible() function by removing its wrapper and directly calling collapse_possible_orders(). The change is functional, as the three callers can test the mask themselves.
